text: A British Airways Boeing 737 skidded off the runway at Orly Airport in Paris on November 16th, 2006, while landing in bad weather. There were no fatalities, although 10 passengers and 2 crew members were injured. The plane received minor undercarriage damage. How many people died in the accident in Paris?
